items.prompt: A student describes a chart. Which sentence is grammatically correct?

visual.text: The number of visitors rose from 200 to 350.

choices.say: The number of visitors rose from 200 to 350.

visual.text: The number of visitors raised from 200 to 350.

choices.say: The number of visitors raised from 200 to 350.

visual.text: The number of visitors rised from 200 to 350.

choices.say: The number of visitors rised from 200 to 350.

visual.text: The number of visitor rose from 200 to 350.

choices.say: The number of visitor rose from 200 to 350.

items.reteach: "Rise – rose – risen" (naik sendiri); "raise" perlu objek. "The number of + plural noun".
